cards.title: Amazing Experience
cards.description: Switched from three different tools to just this one. The workflow is seamless and the team onboarded in a single afternoon.
cards.highlight: Replaced three tools in one afternoon.

cards.title: Highly Recommended
cards.description: Customer support responded in under five minutes and solved a critical production issue before it affected our users.
cards.highlight: Five-minute support response on a Sunday night.

cards.title: Very Intuitive
cards.description: I handed it to a non-technical founder with zero explanation. She had her first project set up within twenty minutes.
cards.highlight: Zero learning curve for non-technical users.

cards.title: Fast on Every Device
cards.description: I manage everything from my phone during commutes. Pages snap open instantly even on a slow 4G connection.
cards.highlight: Genuinely usable on a slow mobile connection.

cards.title: Looks Truly Professional
cards.description: Clients have complimented the interface thinking it was custom-built. The design system is just that polished.

cards.title: Up and Running in Minutes
cards.description: From account creation to first live project took me eleven minutes. The setup wizard is genuinely the best I have seen.
cards.highlight: Eleven minutes from signup to live.

cards.title: Collaboration Changed Everything
cards.description: Our remote team across four time zones finally feels in sync. Real-time updates mean nobody is ever working on stale data.
cards.highlight: Four time zones, one source of truth.

cards.title: Cleanest Interface I Have Used
cards.description: Every action is exactly where you expect it. After two years of use I have never needed to search the docs for navigation.
cards.highlight: Two years in, never opened the docs once.

cards.title: Docs That Actually Help
cards.description: Every page has a working code example, a video walkthrough, and a troubleshooting section. This is how documentation should be done.

cards.title: Rock Solid in Production
cards.description: We launched a campaign that spiked traffic by 40x overnight. Zero downtime, zero errors. The infrastructure just held.
cards.highlight: 40x traffic spike and not a single error.

cards.title: Worth Every Cent
cards.description: We calculated the time saved across the team each month. The ROI pays for an entire year's subscription in the first week.
cards.highlight: Pays for itself in the first week.

cards.title: Keeps Getting Better
cards.description: Every update ships something meaningful. The team listens to feedback and you can see your suggestions appear in the changelog.
cards.highlight: You can see your feedback ship in the next release.
